title: Influential neighbor probability bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let $T$ be a table of functions on the Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$, and let $0\le\epsilon\le1$. For any vertex $v$ and coordinate $i$ that is notable for the averaged neighbor function at $v$ (its stable influence at parameter $1-\epsilon$ exceeds $\epsilon$), the probability that a uniformly chosen neighbor has the corresponding permuted coordinate among its influential coordinates (those with influence at least $\epsilon/2$) is at least $\epsilon/2$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game and a bounded table
A vertex and coordinate notable for the averaged neighbor function
